item.title: I Just Want My Dang Computer to Work
item.description: When it comes to my computer, I tend to keep things simple these days. I don’t want to put up a fight or constantly have to fix what isn’t broken. I’m not looking for endless tweaks, flashy extras, or software “experiments” that end up breaking something down the line. I simply want my system to start up, run smoothly, and get out of the way so I can actually use it.
